verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is documented as an MDX-based static site generator, and nothing in the evidence shows a visual web editor that lets non-technical teammates edit without git and sync changes back to the source. The docusaurus.new browser playground is for trying Docusaurus out, not a collaborative editor tied to the source of truth, so it is adjacent at best. A visual editor is a fair question for a docs tool, so this is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a technical writer, non-technical teammates can edit docs in a visual web editor without touching git, and their changes flow into the same source of truth
